html:Hvis dit mål er stærk månedlig indt: If your goal is strong monthly income from day one, Denmark is the wrong market — higher-yielding European cities deliver that better. If your goal is long-term wealth in a stable, transparent economy, Denmark is a strong candidate.
html:I brede træk afhænger berettigelsen: Broadly speaking, your eligibility depends on your residency and ties to Denmark. EU/EEA citizens who live and work in Denmark generally have an easier path. Buyers without Danish residency typically need permission from the Ministry of Justice, and the rules differ for permanent residences and holiday homes. Because the details depend on your nationality and situation, you should confirm your specific eligibility with a Danish property lawyer early on — it shapes everything else.
